sn35.162:1.1: kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko yena Bhagavā || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn35.162:2.1: Yaṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Kiñca Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ || || Cakkhuṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || Rupā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || Cakkhusamphasso anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo || Yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo || Rasā aniccā || Jivhāviññāṇaṃ || Jivhāsamphasso || Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Kāyo || || Mano anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo || Dhammā aniccā || Manoviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || Yam kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || Atha
